crop.notes: Whole item under 'The Prize Ring' heading.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reprinted a New York Sun report that Joe Goss had come to America to fight Tom Allen, and that a match was made in Cincinnati through William Allen, with a $500 forfeit put up.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch, Friday Evening, May 5, 1876'. Before 1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch. Item is reprinted from the New York Sun of the day before.

facts.fact: A match between Allen and Joe Goss was made in Cincinnati: William Allen, authorized by Tom Allen, put up a $500 forfeit, covered by Goss's admirer John Brown, with Eph. Holland of Cincinnati as stakeholder

notes: The facts index has an unnumbered (000) fact about a relative named William in Cincinnati scheduling a match; this is probably that fact.
